# Positions

::: hanging-indent
**PhD Candidate in Psychometrics**, University of Groningen \| 2025, September–present\
*Models for Computer Adaptive Testing of Cognitive Functions*, funded by KWF.

**Research Assistant**, University of Groningen \| 2025, January–2025, July\
Re-analysed cross-national studies with spatial and phylogenetic Bayesian regression methods to account for cross-national statistical dependencies.

**Research Assistant**, University of Groningen \| 2024, February–2025, February\
Developed two new sample-size planning methods for Bayesian interval testing in 2 × 2 factorial designs, integrated them with two existing methods into an R package and a server-hosted Shiny app, and coordinated the project with (inter)national collaborators.

**Statistics and Research Consultant**, The Methodology Shop, University of Groningen \| 2024, January–2025, August\
Delivered statistical consultation and methodological guidance to (Ph.D.) students and staff, covering Bachelor/Master theses, Ph.D. dissertations, (inter)national research projects, and proposals for theses and doctoral studies.

**Research Assistant**, University of Groningen \| 2023, October–2023, December\
Collected data for an experimental study and monitored the study's progress.

**Teaching Assistant, Statistics II**, B.Sc. Psychology, University of Groningen \| 2022, September–2025, January\
Prepared and facilitated practical sessions on statistical methods in the Statistics II course.
:::
